33:   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (

35:     user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
36:     name TEXT NOT NULL,
37:     description TEXT DEFAULT '',

39:     FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
40:   );
41: `);

44:

70:     res.status(401).json({ error: 'missing authorization header' });
71:     return;

2: import { buildSite } from './site-generator';

4: function usage(): void {
5:   console.error('Usage: ssg build [--content <dir>] [--output <dir>] [--templates <dir>]');
6: }
7: 
8: function parseOptions(args: string[]): { contentDir?: string; outputDir?: string; templatesDir?: string } {
9:   const options: { contentDir?: string; outputDir?: string; templatesDir?: string } = {};
10:   for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 1) {
11:     const option = args[index];
12:     if (option !== '--content' && option !== '--output' && option !== '--templates') {
13:       throw new Error(`Unknown option: ${option}`);
14:     }
15:     const value = args[++index];
16:     if (!value || value.startsWith('--')) throw new Error(`${option} requires a directory`);
17:     if (option === '--content') options.contentDir = value;
18:     else if (option === '--output') options.outputDir = value;
19:     else options.templatesDir = value;
20:   }
21:   return options;
22: }
23: 
24: async function main(): Promise<void> {
25:   const [command, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2);
26:   if (command !== 'build') {
27:     usage();
28:     process.exitCode = 1;
29:     return;
30:   }
31:   try {
32:     const result = await buildSite(parseOptions(args));
33:     console.log(`Built ${result.pages.length} page${result.pages.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`);
34:   } catch (error) {
35:     console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
36:     process.exitCode = 1;
37:   }
38: }

40: void main();
